baseline_weaknesses: Flat solid beige window background lacking warm storybook studio or creative tabletop atmosphere
Stark flat white canvas rectangle with zero depth framing, shadow grounding, or paper mat borders
Flat color circles on a bare strip lacking tactile dish/well beveling or clear radiant active selection state
Generic black dot radio circles for brush size selection lacking visual charm and brush stroke clarity
Hard-to-read line glyphs on top toolbar buttons lacking tactile child affordance and depth
Floating bare status dot without explanatory grounding or child-readable pill container

studio_background.derivation: Storybook warm cream studio tabletop with subtle top-to-bottom warmth and mat horizon line.
studio_background.rationale: Creates a cozy, focused art desk environment without consuming drawing area.

canvas_paper_framing.derivation: Tactile paper canvas with multi-layered drop shadow, rounded corners, and crisp mat border.
canvas_paper_framing.rationale: Positions the child's drawing as the hero surface with physical paper grounding.

palette_and_color_wells.rationale: Tactile ceramic color wells with gloss highlights and radiant golden selection rings.

brush_size_controls.rationale: Intuitive droplet brush tip icons indicating fine, medium, and broad wash strokes.

toolbar_icon_controls.rationale: Charming, tactile child-sized buttons for Gallery, Undo, New Canvas, and Eraser with clear active states.

gallery_sketch_cards.rationale: Miniature sketch cards with white paper mounts and subtle drop shadows for saved paintings.

status_pill_badge.rationale: Clean pill badge displaying real-time saving and saved state (Salvo / Salva... / Errore) with green checkmark.

gameplay_and_persistence.rationale: 100% preservation of PaintingRepository, StrokeHistory, autosave idle loop, undo limits, and platform Home button integration.

compose_adapt_resources_and_derivations.notes: Warm studio surface framing the canvas

canonical_character_decision.rationale: Painting is a dedicated child-first creative creation canvas. Adding a mascot would clutter the toolbars or reduce drawing surface. A clean, tactile storybook studio atmosphere delivers maximum creative freedom.

runtime_architecture.renderer: Direct Pygame surface rendering with pre-rasterized build-time PNG icons
runtime_architecture.image_loading: Loaded once on startup, cached by key, zero per-frame disk I/O
runtime_architecture.sandbox_compliance: Zero forbidden imports (no os or sys inside activity package)
runtime_architecture.resolution_independence: ChildUiMetrics responsive scaling across Normal, Large, and Compact viewports

focused_tests_and_results.coverage: Painting repository persistence, stroke history bounds, undo limits, manifest compliance, forbidden imports check, and runtime asset integrity.

fault_injection_and_restoration.behavior: When decorative PNG assets are unavailable, activity gracefully falls back to clean procedural geometric renditions without crashing.

library_gap_analysis.rationale: Painting successfully authored its specialized creation toolbars, brushes, and color dishes as Activity-local assets. Generic Batch B remains unauthorized.
